name: @araskova/aerial
description: Ultra-high performance 120 FPS infinite canvas and ideation framework powered by Rust, WebAssembly, and Yrs CRDTs.
author: Araskova Labs <dev@araskova.com>

scripts.ios:build: bun run build && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --target aarch64-apple-ios --features custom-protocol --release --lib && mkdir -p src-tauri/gen/apple/Externals/arm64/Release && cp target/aarch64-apple-ios/release/libaerial.a src-tauri/gen/apple/Externals/arm64/Release/libapp.a && xcodebuild -project src-tauri/gen/apple/aerial.xcodeproj -scheme aerial_iOS -configuration release -destination "id=$(xcrun devicectl list devices | grep connected | head -n 1 | awk '{print $3}')" build
scripts.ios:install: xcrun devicectl device install app --device "$(xcrun devicectl list devices | grep connected | head -n 1 | awk '{print $3}')" ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/aerial-*/Build/Products/release-iphoneos/Aerial.app
scripts.ios:launch: xcrun devicectl device process launch --device "$(xcrun devicectl list devices | grep connected | head -n 1 | awk '{print $3}')" com.araskova.aerial
